code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACC={"GAT2":"P40209","GLN3":"P18494","GAT1":"P43574","DAL80":"P26343","GZF3":"P42944"}
S={}
for n,a in ACC.items():
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")
    S[n]="".join(t[1:])

ZF={"GAT2":(472,497),"GLN3":(306,330),"GAT1":(310,334),"DAL80":(31,55),"GZF3":(131,155)}
BASIC=set("KR")
def basic_clusters(s,w=20,thr=7):
    hits=[(i+1,i+w) for i in range(len(s)-w+1) if sum(c in BASIC for c in s[i:i+w])>=thr]
    out=[]
    for a,b in hits:
        if out and a<=out[-1][1]: out[-1][1]=max(out[-1][1],b)
        else: out.append([a,b])
    return out
def mono_nls(s): return [m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r"(?=[KR][KR].[KR])", s)]
def nes(s): return [m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r"(?=[LIVFM].{2,3}[LIVFM].{2,3}[LIVFM].[LIVFM])", s)]
def ser_density(s,w=40):
    return np.array([100*sum(c=="S" for c in s[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2])/len(s[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2]) for i in range(len(s))])

order=["GAT2","GLN3","GAT1","GZF3","DAL80"]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2.1,1]})
ax=axes[0]
for k,n in enumerate(order):
    s=S[n]; y=len(order)-k
    ax.plot([1,len(s)],[y,y],color="#B9BEC7",lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=1)
    a,b=ZF[n]; ax.plot([a,b],[y,y],color="#2F5D8C",lw=13,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=3)
    for ca,cb in basic_clusters(s):
        ax.plot([ca,cb],[y+0.22,y+0.22],color="#C1553B",lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=3)
    ax.scatter(mono_nls(s),[y+0.40]*len(mono_nls(s)),marker="v",s=55,color="#1E7A5E",zorder=4)
    ax.scatter(nes(s),[y-0.30]*len(nes(s)),marker="^",s=40,color="#8A6BBE",zorder=4)
    ax.text(-20,y,n,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(len(s)+12,y,f"{len(s)} aa",ha="left",va="center",fontsize=9,color="#555")
ax.set_xlim(-130,820); ax.set_ylim(0.3,len(order)+0.9); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue position")
ax.set_title("Nuclear-transport signal architecture of Saccharomyces cerevisiae GATA factors\n"
             "blue = GATA Cys4 finger, red = basic cluster (>=7 K/R in 20 aa), green triangle = classical (K/R)(K/R)X(K/R) NLS, purple = leucine-rich NES-like",
             fontsize=10,loc="left")
for sp in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

ax2=axes[1]
for n,c in zip(order,["#C1553B","#2F5D8C","#1E7A5E","#8A6BBE","#B08A2E"]):
    d=ser_density(S[n]); ax2.plot(np.arange(1,len(d)+1),d,label=f"{n} (S={100*S[n].count('S')/len(S[n]):.1f}%)",color=c,lw=1.6)
ax2.set_xlabel("residue position"); ax2.set_ylabel("serine % (40 aa window)")
ax2.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=5,frameon=False); ax2.set_xlim(-130,820)
for sp in ("top","right"): ax2.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
ax2.set_title("Serine density: the substrate feature of TORC1/GAAC-controlled Gln3 and Gat1 phospho-regulation",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- table artifact ----
rows=[]
for n in order:
    s=S[n]
    rows.append(dict(protein=n,length=len(s),ZF=f"{ZF[n][0]}-{ZF[n][1]}",
        ZF_loop=len(re.search(r"C.{2}C(.{15,22}?)C.{2}C",s).group(1)),
        ZF_rel_pos=round(ZF[n][0]/len(s),2),
        pct_S=round(100*s.count("S")/len(s),1),
        n_classicalNLS=len(mono_nls(s)), n_basic_clusters=len(basic_clusters(s)),
        basic_clusters=";".join(f"{a}-{b}" for a,b in basic_clusters(s)),
        n_NESlike=len(nes(s))))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
